categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Skyverse Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on high-end semiconductor quality control, providing comprehensive yield management solutions including equipment products, intelligent software products, and related services. The company offers a full range of inspection and metrology equipment covering all key process steps in integrated circuit manufacturing, as well as AI and big data-based software to enhance semiconductor manufacturing yield.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary optical inspection technology, deep ultraviolet imaging scanning, high-precision multi-mode interference metrology, and advanced defect recognition algorithms. It integrates AI and big data analytics into its software products for defect classification and yield management. Production involves precision assembly, calibration, and testing of semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment, with continuous R&D investment to upgrade products for advanced process nodes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic integrated circuit manufacturers across logic, memory, power semiconductors, MEMS, compound semiconductors (SiC, GaN, GaAs), advanced packaging (wafer-level, 2.5D/3D), large silicon wafer producers, and semiconductor equipment manufacturers (etch, deposition, CMP). The company serves primarily semiconductor foundries and packaging firms in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and multiple wholly-owned subsidiaries across major Chinese cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Qingdao, Tianjin, and Nanjing. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, supporting international business and supply chain.
categories.supply_chain_position: Skyverse operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in semiconductor quality control equipment and software that support wafer fabrication and packaging processes. It supplies critical inspection and metrology tools essential for process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in optical detection, AI-driven defect classification, and automation software to meet evolving semiconductor process requirements. It invests heavily in R&D to break foreign monopolies in China’s semiconductor equipment market, focusing on next-generation inspection technologies for advanced nodes and packaging. Talent development and intellectual property protection are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment, supplemented by sales of intelligent software products and related services. The company uses a direct sales model, engaging customers through negotiations, tenders, and agency promotions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment market is dominated by international giants like KLA Corporation, Applied Materials, and Hitachi. Skyverse positions itself as a leading domestic high-end semiconductor quality control equipment provider, competing directly with foreign incumbents by leveraging localized service, customization, and rapid innovation to capture growing Chinese market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.38 billion, a 54.94% increase year-over-year, driven by expanded product offerings and market penetration. Despite a net loss attributable to increased R&D investment and stock-based compensation, the company’s total assets grew 22.75% to RMB 4.21 billion, reflecting rapid scale expansion and capital investment. R&D expenses accounted for 36.07% of revenue, underscoring a growth strategy focused on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Skyverse emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering all key semiconductor process steps, combining advanced optical inspection technologies with AI-powered software to form a closed-loop yield management system. Its competitive edge lies in high sensitivity, throughput, and precision tailored to domestic customers’ needs, enabling effective defect detection and process control to improve chip yield and performance. Localized support and rapid iteration further differentiate its offerings from foreign competitors.
